cultural_variations: Thumbs-up is insulting in Iran and parts of Africa.
OK hand sign is vulgar in Brazil and Turkey.
In Japan, prolonged eye contact during interviews reads as disrespectful.
In Latin America, closer interview spacing signals warmth and trust.
In Japan, handshakes are light, brief, and often preceded by a bow.
In conservative Islamic regions, men may avoid shaking women's hands.
In Latin America, firmer, longer handshakes reflect rapport.
In Western and non-Western cultures, pride's raised-arms display is recognized universally.
In East Asian cultures, openly displaying pride may read as boastful.
